e.w: Ephraim appears next to the golem: the golem is named Bob, built from Behemoth and Leviathan; a failsafe was built with others; the party jumps via a time anchor (drinking contest, boat, mushroom) to Skjall during the wall construction hundreds of years earlier.

In the past they see Tautok (mid-transition) finishing the Monument; Tautok takes Barzan's mushroom and gives it to Ephraim: the failsafe is the Monument, to trigger it the national borders must be moved (unclaimed land with Shifters, or Nolia); Ephraim admits the second ritual was a misguided step.
On the ship, 500 years in the past (home countdown 42 days): Barzan and BB gather lore on the Unclaimed Lands (Shifters, tribes, family-based, no rulers; border markers vanish).
Flight over the lake and the second-largest city of Nolia (which does not exist yet in the party's time) with the Climbing Church; they land in the Unclaimed Lands.
A five-person patrol (Sterak, Linsea, Kelpi, Huton, Uossa) surrounds them; tense talk, Barzan on religion, the party builds a shelter together; they gift a +1 armour.

Underground/at the shelter evening: tea with alcohol, music, trade questions; Leumas (Persuasion 36) reveals they are time travellers trying to save the world; patrol mentions Hobgoblin Jeska; the city by the lake sometimes attacks.

Night: Lorilla keeps watch with the elf, hears whistles (call and response); Leumas (Nat 20) spots 5 uniformed city scouts; combat begins, session ends mid-fight (Barzan's Hallow, Elo's double-nat-20 kill).
